scenes.text: You opened YouTube "for one video" 40 minutes ago. Here's the fix.

scenes.title: Write your blocklist.

scenes.title: Block on a schedule.
scenes.body: Not when you "feel distracted" — e.g. **9–12 and 1–5** on weekdays.

scenes.title: Every device at once.
scenes.body: Laptop **and** phone — or you'll just switch screens.

scenes.title: Lock the session.
scenes.body: So you **can't turn it off** mid-block.

scenes.sub: Plus the app setup that syncs it across devices.
